data.name: City Park Hotel Sochi
data.hotelDescription:
Luxurious Amenities

Indulge in massages, body treatments, and facials. Enjoy a water park, indoor pool, and sauna at our hotel. Complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and gift shops for your convenience.

All-Inclusive Experience

Savor Modern European cuisine at Cinema restaurant. All-inclusive rates cover meals and drinks. Grab a drink at the bar and enjoy buffet breakfasts daily.

Business and Event Facilities

Featuring a business center, limo service, and express check-out. With a conference center and 5 meeting rooms, our hotel is perfect for events. Roundtrip airport shuttle and train station pick-up available.

For an unforgettable stay in Sochi, steps away from local attractions, book your room at City Park Hotel Sochi today!
data.hotelImportantInformation:
• If you require a visa to enter the country, your property may be able to help with the supporting documents needed to obtain one. To learn more, you can reach out to the property via the contact details included on your booking confirmation. The property may charge for this assistance, even if you end up cancelling your reservation. All arrangements are solely between the property and yourself.
  • Russian citizens: Adults (aged 14 and over) must present a valid internal passport at check-in (international Russian passports and driver's licenses are not accepted). Birth certificates must be presented for all Russian children (aged under 14) at check-in. If a Russian relative or legal guardian (rather than a parent) is traveling in Russia with a child under 14, that relative or legal guardian is also required to present documentation certifying authority to accompany child at check-in. Non-Russian citizens: Adults and children must present a valid passport, visa, and migration card at check-in.
  • Pool access available from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
  • Reservations are required for massage services and spa treatments. Reservations can be made by contacting the hotel prior to arrival, using the contact information on the booking confirmation.
  • Up to 2 children 4 years old and younger stay free when occupying the parent or guardian's room, using existing bedding.
A deposit may be required at the property.

instructions.instruction: The name on the credit card used at check-in to pay for incidentals must be the primary name on the guestroom reservation
Government-issued photo identification and a credit card, debit card, or cash deposit may be required at check-in for incidental charges

checkinCheckoutTimes.special_instructions: This property offers transfers from the airport and train station (surcharges may apply). To arrange pick-up, guests must contact the property 24 hours prior to arrival, using the contact information on the booking confirmation. Front desk staff will greet guests on arrival at the property.
